name: scraper_project
description: This folder contains the tooling that collects product reviews, walks through pagination, and saves the results in JSONL/CSV form for later analysis. The project includes a tiny synthetic catalogue so the pipeline can be exercised without touching the network, plus CLI switches for real-world runs.

scripts.scrape_help:
node -e "console.log('Available scripts:
- npm run scrape -> collect product IDs from category URLs in categories.txt
- npm run scrape_review_def -> collect reviews with default concurrency 3
- npm run previous_scrapes -> list previous review runs
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId> -> resume a previous run
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only -> retry failed jobs from latest failed list
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --categories=<slug1,slug2> -> only selected categories
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --products=<id1,id2> -> only selected product IDs
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --concurrency=<n> -> override worker count
- you can combine filters, for example: node collection_auto_rawData.js --categories=mobilya --products=734699208,734700038 --concurrency=4')"
